plugins.name: shipgate
plugins.description: Lean, gate-driven feature development: route by CLAUDE.md, explore in parallel, clarify before building, design with options, orchestrate by model tier, never claim done without evidence, review against design, capture durable learnings. Run /shipgate:setup to record flow state in an append-only journal instead of re-inferring it. Configure per project via .claude/shipgate.md; integrations degrade gracefully.

plugins.name: astrolabe
plugins.description: Typed functional code style: types first, immutability, smart constructors, illegal states unrepresentable, effects at the edges. Examples in TypeScript, principles language-portable; pairs with a per-project skill for local specifics.

plugins.name: bpmn
plugins.description: BPMN 2.0 diagrams from plain language: Claude writes the semantic XML, bundled tooling auto-layouts (pools, lanes, boundary events), validates with bpmnlint, and renders a self-contained HTML preview — no manual bpmn.io fixup loop.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Control Herdr from a Claude session: split panes, start and name sibling agents, run commands elsewhere, read output and wait on state. Redistributes the upstream Herdr skill under Apache-2.0, pinned to a known Herdr release.
